HMCI’s name.

Decks, videos, pages, reports. Without one creative owner, they look different. That weakens the trusted, neutral voice the SMUD proposal depends on.

What HMCI getsCreative ownership as the partnership grows.03 / 15
Speaker note

The proposed SMUD partnership spans government relations, commercial real estate and power, an AI infrastructure platform, SMUD and NVIDIA research, and IR² community reinvestment. Each creates public-facing material. Under the proposal, operators give $0.01 per verified kWh to a local 501(c)(3), with annual public reporting. A shared creative owner helps protect HMCI’s neutral voice.

Source & context
  • Regional AI Infrastructure Partnership details supplied by Antonie Lewis. Presented as proposed work, not an awarded engagement.
